title: Parity from positive-coordinate count
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the coordinates $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and let $x\\in\\{ -1,1\\}^n$. If $k$ is the number of coordinates in $S$ at which $x$ equals $1$, then the parity function associated to $S$, evaluated at $x$, is $(-1)^{\\max(|S|-k,0)}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector on the $n$ coordinates
